purpose: Make Pantheon's request qualification, provider selection, bounded completion fallback, private decision evidence, and actual ask surface independently replaceable without claiming unqualified modalities or runtime evidence.

separate_owner_boundaries.unqualified_modalities: Streaming request qualification, JSON response-mode qualification, and deterministic-generation qualification remain open; declarations or adapter wire shape are not proof.

prohibited: privacy=local-only never selects or falls back to a remote provider
unknown or invalid request classes and negative context requirements fail closed before provider probes
only a structured eligible remote 429 or recognized structured 402 quota/budget refusal may trigger one qualified local fallback
cancellation, deadline, authentication, malformed, or unstructured errors are not converted into indiscriminate retries
decision evidence never contains prompts, measured summaries, answer text, raw errors, response bodies, bearer values, or credentials
a command-writer regression must not be hidden by weakening existing ask assertions or redirecting unrelated process-global output

this recipe and its source mapping do not establish additional qualification, model behavior, performance, or a successful real routed answer; qualification remains bound to its exact source and evidence tuple

existing ordered provider ladder, per-provider availability, and declared provider.Caps
outputs: first available provider that satisfies the represented context requirement, selected in existing task/privacy tier order
explicit refusal category when request validation, privacy, availability, or represented context qualification fails
initial/final lane and rationale in the existing modelrouter.Decision
writes: no provider or configuration mutation; routing can record one decision through the injected bounded DecisionSink
upgrade_recipe: keep internal/modelrouter as the only routing-policy owner
validate task, privacy, latency, override, and nonnegative context before probing
apply one availability-plus-represented-capability predicate in normal, override, escalation, and fallback selection
keep local-only dominant over override and every fallback
preserve zero/unset defaults and existing tier ordering
do not claim streaming, JSON response mode, or deterministic generation is qualified until the request can express each requirement and a backend declaration/evidence path satisfies it
qualify focused normal/race and semantic-negative tests before acceptance

inputs: existing provider configuration and explicitly selected local profile
provider-declared availability, context, streaming, tool, and offline capability fields
existing configured credentials only when already supplied through their established boundary
outputs: the existing provider ladder and declared capability values consumed by model-router selection
profile/config refusal when required declared metadata is missing or malformed

the same validated request privacy and minimum-context requirements used during initial selection
outputs: at most one qualified local fall-down for an eligible remote 429 or recognized structured 402 quota/budget refusal
final response and Decision identify the final provider/lane, or an error retaining both remote and fallback causes
redacted exhaustion category and outcome recorded once

treat joined cancellation/deadline as terminal even when the parent remains live

preserve both provider causes if fallback fails and never repeat inference to repair evidence

provider/model labels, final route, reason, outcome, and structured failure category after redaction

surface journal failure without repeating provider execution
